title: Uncertain Pickaxe
body:
-"The Corrupt Pickaxe: a daily companion of charm and power, crafted with Tupi mastery and Furpz wood. Unveiling hidden paths and ores, it empowers adventurers and builders alike."-

Description

The Uncertain Pickaxe, also known as the Corrupt Pickaxe, is a special quest pickaxe obtained by placing 3 pieces of Infused Ink onto the active pedestals located around the map. It is the first pickaxe to have a unique ability, which is that it causes small Mysterious Mushrooms to grow out of an ore vein when it is hit. The Mysterious Mushrooms damage surrounding rocks and produce a continuous "boo-womp" sound effect from SpongeBob SquarePants.

It has been observed that for the Infused Ink pieces to work on the pedestals, assuming their length is 1 and width is 2, height must be higher than 2. Regardless if cut to that size or not.

Appearance

The Uncertain Pickaxe takes appearance of a miniature Mysterious Mushroom with a Fungiviolet blade impaled through it, being covered in mycelium.

Obtaining

Note: As of 1.62.0 the pickaxe's ownership will be automatically assigned to whoever placed the Infused Ink on the 3 pedestals.

  • Go to Mike's Mines and find the small red trigger located deep within the mine. The trigger can be reached by navigating the hanging boards over the underground lake, best done using a Gravity Coil. Note, however, that there are a few dead ends- the correct path leads to a rusty truss. If the button is nowhere to be seen, this means that a person in your server already toggled the quest; you can then skip that part and go to the next quest.
    Trigger for quest in Mike's Mines
    Trigger for quest in Mike's Mines
    Way to trigger in new mike's mines
    Way to trigger in new mike's mines
  • Find and refine/forge 3 pieces of Inkstone. The pieces should be big enough (approximately 4 studs in volume), or else the pedestal may not register it as a valid step towards completing the Uncertain Pickaxe quest.
  • Go to Uncertainty Cave and make a Mysterious Mushroom fire a glowing purple spore at a piece of the refined Inkstone. If successful, a "boo-womp" sound effect will be heard and the refined/forged Ink will transform into Infused Ink. Repeat this process with the remaining 2 pieces of refined/forged Ink.
  • Place a piece of Infused Ink on each of the three pedestals around the map- in the desert canyon, near Alan's AutoLogistics, and in the Lost Woods near the Lighthouse. When the quest is active, these pedestals will have a red ring around them and emit a barely-audible bass humming sound. When Infused Ink is placed on them, they should emit a pink aura and shoot a beam pointing toward the center pedestal.
  • If successful, three poof sounds will be heard across the whole server, followed with a louder poof noise. This is the pickaxe spawning. Get to the top of the hill in the Acidlands (the area with the poison effect) to claim the Uncertain Pickaxe near the center pedestal. The pedestal is on a rock with spires jutting out of it.

Trivia

  • After 15th of March 2024 the pickaxe got a remodel, making it look more fitting to the theme of a tool made out of fungal infused materials. It was made by community members @mr_peeka_boo, @xphrogx and @aylien who drew the concept, provided feedback and modelled it respectively.
  • The words "Corrupt", "Daily", "Tupi" and "Furpz" referenced in it's description are actually names of 4 known members of the Typical Developers Discord server; Corrupt, Dailyyy, Tupisupi, and Furpz.
  • The concept of this pickaxe heavily resembles the Spore Pickaxe from Refinery Caves. This is possibly because those who suggested the Uncertain Pickaxe's addition were/are fans of that game.
  • It is the first pickaxe that is obtainable via completion of a quest.
  • Before being discovered, Daily, Furpz, and Tupisupi were leaving cryptic messages, which have been revealed to be pieces of the item's description. Those messages were "Daily companion", "Furpz wood" and "Tupi mastery".
  • The Uncertain Pickaxe is capable of destroying entire ore nodes in a couple of swings due to its special ability.
